content.text: This does not do anything to assist users with the changes to how etags work in 4.7.1.  I had considered changing the If-Match and If-Not-Match setters to strip off the "W/" prefix and ensure the string is quoted when adding the header, so that applications could reuse the etag from a response when performing subsequent requests without having to do extra parsing.  But I'll hold off on that until someone else indicates that is desirable.

comments.body:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-java-client/pull/24

This does not do anything to assist users with the changes to how etags work in 4.7.1. I had considered changing the If-Match and If-Not-Match setters to strip off the "W/" prefix and ensure the string is quoted when adding the header, so that applications could reuse the etag from a response when performing subsequent requests without having to do extra parsing. But I'll hold off on that until someone else indicates that is desirable.

Additional possible commit which replaces substringing of the etag with helpers that work with EntityTag objects:
https://github.com/bbpennel/fcrepo-java-client/commit/e6285ad5c127eb35f1dad215f805ee0a2a7ce600

Let me know if one of these options looks better than the other.

Former user, When this ticket is ready for review, please move its state from "Start Work" to "Start Review".
Thanks.
